package com.x;
public class CompressorControl {
  boolean dischargeHigh;
  int step(int target, int available, int autoOn, boolean suctionValid, boolean low, boolean x, boolean y, Cfg c) {
    if (c.minStagesOn > 0)
    {
      int handCount = 0;
      target = Math.max(target, c.minStagesOn - handCount);
    }
    target = Math.min(target, available);
    if (dischargeHigh) target = Math.min(target, autoOn);
    if (suctionValid && low) target = Math.min(target, autoOn - 1);
    if (x) {
      a();
      target = Math.min(target, 1);
    }
    if (x) a(); else target = Math.min(target, 2);
    if (y)
      target = Math.min(target, 3);
    return target;
  }
}
-- src/com/x/BCompressorControl.java --
package com.x;
@NiagaraProperty(name = "dischargeHighAlarm", type = "BStatusBoolean", defaultValue = "new BStatusBoolean(false)", flags = Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY)
public class BCompressorControl extends BComponent {
  void publish(CompressorControl ctl) {
    getDischargeHighAlarm().setValue(ctl.dischargeHigh);
  }
}
